name: elbow to knee twists
description: A standing move where you twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It raises your pulse and works the sides of your waist.
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.
